faults.name: back-loses-time
faults.caughtAs: Back to the Room step did not preserve the chosen time

faults.name: review-not-refreshed
faults.caughtAs: Review does not show the exact time: 09:00 should have become 14:00

faults.name: back-clears-room
faults.caughtAs: Back did not preserve the chosen room(?!:)

faults.name: plain-buttons-back-clears-room
faults.caughtAs: Back did not preserve the chosen room: Continue is disabled on the Room step

faults.name: review-back-loses-time
faults.caughtAs: Back from Review did not preserve the chosen time

faults.name: review-back-clears-count
faults.caughtAs: Back from Review did not preserve the participant count

faults.name: start-over-keeps-time
faults.caughtAs: Start over kept the chosen time

faults.name: start-over-keeps-count
faults.caughtAs: Start over kept the participant count

faults.name: time-not-required
faults.caughtAs: Continue must stay disabled until a time is chosen

faults.name: count-not-required
faults.caughtAs: Continue must stay disabled without a participant count

faults.name: review-count-before-room-change
faults.caughtAs: Review does not show the exact room and participant count: birch, 7 should have become cedar, 4

faults.name: confirm-does-nothing
faults.caughtAs: Confirm did not open a completion panel saying No room was booked

variants.name: select-controls
variants.why: Room and time are select lists (the time list starts on 09:00, so a time is always chosen) and the count is a number input.

variants.name: pressed-button-choices
variants.why: Rooms and times are toggle buttons that expose the choice with aria-pressed instead of radio buttons.

variants.name: plain-button-choices
variants.why: Rooms and times are plain buttons without an exposed state; the choice is written in a sentence below them.
